prompt: Decompose for a new engineer, keeping all facts: 'PUT and DELETE are idempotent, so retrying them after a timeout is safe, but POST is not.'
reference_facts: An idempotent request produces the same result no matter how many times it is repeated.
PUT and DELETE are defined as idempotent HTTP methods.
POST is not idempotent, so retrying it after a timeout can create duplicate records.
